pricing_citation: HYPOTHESIS_LEDGER.md §P7-2(a): F9-19 and the zero-priced diagnostics make no rejection about the Earth; §P7-1(c) / §P7-15 assign this sweep at price 0. Simulated catalogs, sandboxed ledger, no EXPLORE_COUNT line.
predicted_curve_source: §P7-12(a) floor formula inverted: power(k) = Phi(k*(z_alpha+z_0.80) - z_alpha); reproduces §P7-15's published 0.800 / 0.9992 / 1.0000 at 1/1.5/2x
p7_8d_departure: The 1.0x and 1.5x cells sit BELOW the §P7-8(d) 2x plant line, deliberately: the curve cannot be measured without visiting the amplitudes whose power is in question. Misses there are POWER measurements. No G-M1 verdict is taken from this module; G-M1 was decided at >= 2x in results_gate_r1.json.
